//: Treat .sx single-file components as TypeScript so the editor gives syntax highlighting + bracket-pair colorization, and resolves their exports. NOTE: the @styles / @html blocks will show as TS errors until a dedicated .sx language extension exists.
//tailwind: Tailwind CSS IntelliSense only autocompletes inside contexts it recognizes as class lists (class=/className= and known functions). sx passes utilities to .class()/.addClass() and to UPPER_CASE bundle consts, which it does NOT recognize by default. These regexes tell it where our class strings live so autocomplete, hover, and linting work. NOTE: any ALL-CAPS const assigned a string literal is scanned as classes — in this repo those are only the class bundles (VIEW/H2/BTN/LINK).
